description: Correct the rehearsal track's overclaims and rules, harden the fixture contract test to assert a real commit, define the acceptance fields, add the cleanup checks, and record the review with an explicit Accepted Risk for the deferred isolated-session strict path
deviation_notes: All 9 top-level tasks are done and the 3 phase checkpoints are recorded. (1) The strict-path rehearsal remains an Accepted Risk: the fixture session must own the fixture as its working directory, which the agent tool surface cannot do; the review record documents the unproven part and the deferral. (2) The evidence file was extended with the subagent ids, exact commands, the no-deny reason, and the cleanup commands/results; one cleanup re-check found the installed plugin digest stale (the follow-up's compactBand change), fixed by reinstalling and re-running `--check --live`. (3) The fixture contract test was hardened to assert a real commit (positive and negative cases).
